About Me

Who I am and where I am heading.

I am Arnisha Ahmed Nourin from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I am pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Engineering at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB), where I currently hold a CGPA of 3.90 out of 4.00.

My particular interest lies in developing software applications, solving technical problems, and understanding how reliable and efficient software systems are designed. I am especially drawn to software testing and quality assurance, with a focus on identifying and preventing software defects.

I have been a Research Intern at the Advanced Machine Intelligence Research (AMIR) Lab in Banani, Dhaka, since 2025, with a focus on data science (see my AMIR Lab profile). I have co-authored three IEEE conference papers, which were presented in 2026.

Machine Learning · Explainable AI · Software Quality

ChronoDefect: Cross-Version Software Defect Prediction

  • Built a leakage-controlled framework using Logistic Regression, Random Forest, SVM and XGBoost to predict defects in future releases from static code metrics.
  • Evaluated temporal training windows, probability calibration, release drift and LOC-based inspection budgets.
  • Used SHAP and LIME to explain global and local predictions.
  • Found that training on the most recent release improved MCC and PR-AUC.
IoT · Machine Learning · Published at IEEE QPAIN 2026

SoilFlux: IoT-Based Soil NPK Prediction and Smart Irrigation

  • Built a smart agriculture system with an ESP32 and soil moisture, temperature and humidity sensors.
  • Predicted nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium levels from environmental data, explained with SHAP and LIME.
Software Engineering · Scrum

Krishi Connect

An AI-assisted agriculture platform designed with an SRS, UML diagrams, Figma prototypes, Git workflow and testing documentation.

Credit Card Fraud Detection
